title: Maternal Journey Event
description: A reusable schema for representing a de-identified event within a maternal-care continuity journey.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this journey event. Must not contain patient-identifying information.

journey_id.description: Pseudonymous or synthetic identifier used to associate events belonging to the same maternal-care journey.

stage.description: The maternal-care stage in which this event occurred.

care_step.description: A short implementation-neutral identifier for the planned care step.

status.description: Current continuity status of the care step.

event_time.description: Date and time associated with the event, expressed in ISO 8601 format.

expected_completion_time.description: Optional expected completion time for the care step.

completed_time.description: Time the care step was completed, when applicable.

service_available.description: Whether the required provider, facility or service was available when needed.

referral_required.description: Indicates whether progression from this step required a referral.

referral_id.description: Optional de-identified reference to a related referral event.

barriers.description: High-level reasons that delayed or prevented completion of the care step.

continuity_outcome.description: High-level continuity outcome following this event.

region.description: Optional broad implementation region, such as a state or district. Do not use a patient's home address.

source_type.description: General source of the event information.
